skill_name: Compare and contrast the features of a GPT model and a recurrent neural network.
workflow: A GPT model is a type of language model that uses inputted data to create output based on statistical probability of words and phrases within a set of data. A recurrent neural network (RNN) is a type of artificial neural network that is able to analyze data in sets or sequences.
